task: Implement sync_state for the local client without inheriting cloud sync service behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Local client sync_state reconciles local SQLite state with the last-fetched remote snapshot.
Local sync is offline-first; it must not block on network access during the sync pass.
Conflict resolution in the local client prefers the remote snapshot unless local changes are newer.
When sync_state spans local and cloud contexts, verify the offline-first contract before coding.
Cloud sync service: sync_state pushes local delta events to the event bus and waits for ACK.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: cloud push-and-wait sync model conflicts with the offline-first local sync

candidate_memories.content: Old sync note says cloud and local sync logic should share the same sync_state interface.
